realizes.rationale: Configures VITEPRESS_BASE defaulting to /ar-rh-proof-skeleton/, cleanUrls, locked light editorial appearance, MathJax 3 SVG math, and top nav plus Stage 00 (including Proof Journey) and Concept sidebar navigation.

1.note: `normalizeBase` reads `VITEPRESS_BASE` with default `/ar-rh-proof-skeleton/` and enforces leading and trailing slashes.

2.note:
`defineConfig` sets `cleanUrls: true`, light-only `appearance: false` and `markdown.math: true` for build-time MathJax 3 SVG math.

Anchor: `defineConfig`

3.note: `themeConfig` defines 5 top navigation links (including `Proof Journey`), Stage 00 (5 pages including `Full Proof Journey & 20-Step Map`) and Foundational Concepts (index + 12 slugs) sidebar groups, `[2, 3]` outline and `ariaLabel`-annotated GitHub `socialLinks`.
